title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六: 則天皇后
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六: 則天皇后 Volume 6 Annals 6: Empress Wu Zetian

sentences.zh: 則天皇后武氏，諱曌，并州文水人也。

translations.literal: Empress Wu Zetian of the Wu clan bore the taboo name Zhao; she was a native of Wenshui in Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu Zetian, née Wu, bore the taboo name Zhao and came from Wenshui in Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 父士彠，隋大業末為鷹揚府隊正。

translations.literal: Her father Shi Yue, at the end of the Sui dynasty's Daye reign, served as captain of the Eagle-Forging Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Shi Yue, in the closing years of Sui, held the rank of captain in the Eagle-Forging Garrison.

sentences.zh: 高祖行軍于汾、晉，每休止其家。

translations.literal: When Gaozu marched through Fen and Jin, he always rested at their household.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu campaigned through Fen and Jin, he often lodged at their home.

sentences.zh: 義旗初起，從平京城。

translations.literal: When the righteous banner first rose, he followed in the pacification of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the first raising of the rebel standard he joined the march that took the capital.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，累遷工部尚書、荊州都督，封應國公。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era he was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Works and military governor of Jingzhou, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenguan he rose through the Ministry of Works and the Jingzhou governorship to the dukedom of Ying.

sentences.zh: 初，則天年十四時，太宗聞其美容止，召入宮，立為才人。

translations.literal: At first, when Wu Zetian was fourteen, Taizong heard of her beauty and deportment, summoned her to the palace, and installed her as a cairen.
translations.idiomatic: When she was fourteen, Taizong, hearing of her beauty and grace, brought her to court and made her a cairen.

sentences.zh: 及太宗崩，遂為尼，居感業寺。

translations.literal: When Taizong died, she became a nun and dwelt at Ganye Temple.
translations.idiomatic: After Taizong's death she took the tonsure and lived at Ganye Temple.

sentences.zh: 大帝於寺見之，復召入宮，拜昭儀。

translations.literal: The Great Emperor saw her at the temple, summoned her again to the palace, and appointed her Imperial Consort Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong met her at the temple, recalled her to the palace, and created her Imperial Consort Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 時皇后王氏、良娣蕭氏頻與武昭儀爭寵，互讒毀之，帝皆不納。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Wang and Lady Xiao the fair consort repeatedly vied with Consort Wu Zhaoyi for favor, each slandering the other; the emperor accepted none of it.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang and Consort Xiao then fought Consort Wu for the emperor's favor, trading slanders; he believed neither side.

sentences.zh: 進號宸妃。

translations.literal: Her title was advanced to Chen Consort.
translations.idiomatic: She was promoted to Chen Consort.

sentences.zh: 永徽六年，廢王皇后而立武宸妃為皇后。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yonghui, Empress Wang was deposed and Chen Consort Wu was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In Yonghui 6 Empress Wang was deposed and Consort Wu was raised to empress.

sentences.zh: 高宗稱天皇，武后亦稱天后。

translations.literal: Gaozong styled himself Heavenly Sovereign, and Empress Wu styled herself Heavenly Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong took the title Heavenly Sovereign; Empress Wu took that of Heavenly Empress.

sentences.zh: 后素多智計，兼涉文史。

translations.literal: The empress had long been resourceful in stratagem and also versed in letters and history.
translations.idiomatic: She was clever in counsel and well read in the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 帝自顯慶已後，多苦風疾，百司表奏，皆委天后詳決。

translations.literal: From Xianqing onward the emperor often suffered wind ailments; memorials from the hundred offices were all entrusted to the Heavenly Empress for detailed decision.
translations.idiomatic: After Xianqing the emperor was often crippled by wind sickness; every ministry memorial went to the Heavenly Empress for final ruling.

sentences.zh: 自此內輔國政數十年，威勢與帝無異，當時稱為「二聖」。

translations.literal: From this she assisted in governing the realm for several decades; her authority differed in no way from the emperor's, and the age called them the "Two Sages."
translations.idiomatic: For decades she shared rule from within; her power matched the emperor's, and contemporaries named them the Two Sages.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，廢皇帝為廬陵王，幽於別所，仍改賜名哲。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the second month the emperor was deposed as Prince of Luling, confined in a separate residence, and his given name was changed to Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the second month the emperor was demoted to Prince of Luling, shut away, and renamed Zhe.

sentences.zh: 己未，立豫王輪為皇帝，令居於別殿。

translations.literal: On jiwei Prince Lun of Yu was installed as emperor and ordered to dwell in a separate hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince Lun of Yu was enthroned and lodged in a side palace.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，改元文明。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm and the era name changed to Wenming.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed a general amnesty and renamed the era Wenming.

sentences.zh: 皇太后仍臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: The empress dowager still held court and exercised regency.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager continued to rule from behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 庚午，廢皇太孫重照為庶人。

translations.literal: On gengwu the heir's grandson Chongzhao was deposed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the heir's grandson Chongzhao was stripped to common rank.

sentences.zh: 太常卿兼豫王府長史王德真為侍中，中書侍郎、豫王府司馬劉禕之同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Wang Dezhen, Grand Master of Ceremonies and concurrent chief administrator of the Prince of Yu's household, became attendant-in-chief; Liu Yizhi, vice director of the Secretariat and concurrent marshal of the Prince of Yu's household, was made equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dezhen, grand master of ceremonies and chief administrator to the Prince of Yu, became attendant-in-chief; Liu Yizhi, secretariat vice director and the prince's marshal, joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月，庶人賢死于巴州。

translations.literal: In the third month the commoner Xian died in Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the deposed heir Xian died in Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，滕王元嬰薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Prince Yuanying of Teng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Prince Yuanying of Teng died.

sentences.zh: 改封畢王上金為澤王，葛王素節為許王。

translations.literal: Prince Shangjin of Bi was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ze; Prince Sunjie of Ge as Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shangjin of Bi was made Prince of Ze; Prince Sunjie of Ge was made Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遷廬陵王哲於均州。

translations.literal: On dingchou Prince Zhe of Luling was moved to Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Prince Zhe of Luling was exiled to Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，禮部尚書武承嗣同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month Wu Chengsi, Minister of Rites, was made equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month Wu Chengsi, minister of rites, joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，突厥骨咄祿、元珍寇朔州，命左威衛大將軍程務挺拒之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the Turks Kutlug and Yuanzhen raided Shuozhou; the Left Majestic Guard General Cheng Wuting was ordered to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the Turks Kutlug and Yuanzhen struck Shuozhou; Cheng Wuting, general of the left majestic guard, was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 彗星見西北方，長二丈餘，經三十三日乃滅。

translations.literal: A comet appeared in the northwest, more than two zhang in length; after thirty-three days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: A comet blazed in the northwest for thirty-three days, its tail longer than two zhang.

sentences.zh: 九月，大赦天下，改元為光宅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Guangzhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court proclaimed a general amnesty and renamed the era Guangzhai.

sentences.zh: 旗幟改從金色，飾以紫，畫以雜文。

translations.literal: Banners and flags were changed to gold, trimmed with purple and painted with mixed designs.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial banners were recolored gold, edged in purple, and painted with mixed emblems.

sentences.zh: 改東都為神都，又改尚書省及諸司官名。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital was renamed the Divine Capital, and the Secretariat and the names of the various offices were also changed.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang was renamed the Divine Capital, and the Secretariat together with many ministry titles were retitled.

sentences.zh: 初置右肅政御史台官員。

translations.literal: For the first time officials of the Right Office for Censorial Reform were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The court first staffed the Right Office for Censorial Reform.

sentences.zh: 故司空李勣孫柳州司馬徐敬業偽稱揚州司馬，殺長史陳敬之，據揚州起兵，自稱上將，以匡復為辭。

translations.literal: Xu Jingye, grandson of the former Minister of Works Li Ji and prefectural marshal of Liuzhou, falsely styled himself acting prefect of Yangzhou, killed the chief administrator Chen Jingzhi, seized Yangzhou and raised troops, styled himself supreme commander, and took restoration of the dynasty as his pretext.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jingye, grandson of Li Ji and marshal of Liuzhou, posed as acting prefect of Yangzhou, murdered chief administrator Chen Jingzhi, seized the city, declared himself supreme commander, and marched under the banner of restoring Tang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，楚州司馬李崇福率所部三縣以應敬業。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Li Chongfu, prefectural marshal of Chuzhou, led the three counties under his command to join Jingye.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Li Chongfu of Chuzhou rallied his three counties to Jingye's cause.

sentences.zh: 命左玉鈐衛大將軍李孝逸為大總管，率兵三十萬以討之。

translations.literal: Li Xiaoyi, general of the Left Jade-Belled Guard, was appointed grand commander and led three hundred thousand troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiaoyi of the left jade-belled guard was named grand commander and marched with three hundred thousand men to crush the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 殺內史裴炎。

translations.literal: The Grand Secretary Pei Yan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Pei Yan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，追削敬業父祖官爵，復其本姓徐氏。

translations.literal: On dingyou Jingye's father and forebears were posthumously stripped of rank and title, and the clan name was restored to Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court erased Jingye's ancestral honors and restored the clan name Xu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，前中書令薛元超卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the former Grand Secretary Xue Yuanchao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the former grand secretary Xue Yuanchao died.

sentences.zh: 殺左威衛大將軍程務挺。

translations.literal: Cheng Wuting, Left Majestic Guard General, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Wuting, general of the left majestic guard, was executed.

sentences.zh: 垂拱元年春正月，以敬業平，大赦天下，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the inaugural year of Chuigong, after Jingye's suppression a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name installed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Chuigong 1, with Jingye defeated, the court proclaimed a general amnesty and fixed the new era name.

sentences.zh: 劉仁軌薨。

translations.literal: Liu Ren'gui died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ren'gui, the great commander, died.

sentences.zh: 三月，遷廬陵王哲于房州。

translations.literal: In the third month Prince Zhe of Luling was moved to Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Prince Zhe of Luling was transferred to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 頒下親撰《垂拱格》於天下。

translations.literal: The personally drafted Chuigong Code was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Her personally drafted Chuigong Code was issued empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，內史騫味道左授青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Grand Secretary Qian Weidao was demoted and sent out as prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Grand Secretary Qian Weidao was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，秋官尚書裴居道為內史，納言王德真配流象州，冬官尚書蘇良嗣為納言。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Pei Judao, Minister of Autumn, became Grand Secretary; Remonstrator Wang Dezhen was banished to Xiangzhou; Su Liangsi, Minister of Winter, became Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Pei Judao became grand secretary; Wang Dezhen was exiled to Xiangzhou; Su Liangsi became remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 詔內外文武九品已上及百姓，咸令自舉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above, and the common people, all to nominate themselves.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded every official of the ninth rank or higher—and commoners as well—to put forward their own names.

sentences.zh: 是夏大旱。

translations.literal: That summer there was great drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer a severe drought struck.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，皇太后下詔，復政于皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, the empress dowager issued an edict restoring rule to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of her second regnal year the empress dowager edicted the return of power to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 以皇太后既非實意，乃固讓。

translations.literal: Because the empress dowager's intent was not genuine, he firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing her offer was not sincere, he refused it outright.

sentences.zh: 皇太后仍依舊臨朝稱制，大赦天下。

translations.literal: The empress dowager still held court as before and exercised regency, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: She resumed regency as before and proclaimed another general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 初令都督、刺史並准京官帶魚。

translations.literal: For the first time military governors and prefects were likewise permitted to wear the court fish tally like capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time provincial governors and prefects were allowed the court fish tally worn by capital officials.

sentences.zh: 三月，初置匭於朝堂，有進書言事者聽投之，由是人間善惡事多所知悉。

translations.literal: In the third month chests were first set up in the audience hall; those submitting memorials or reports were permitted to deposit them, and thereby good and ill in the realm became widely known.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month complaint boxes were placed in the audience hall; anyone with a petition could deposit it, and court and country alike learned what the people knew.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，岑長倩為內史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Cen Changqian became Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Cen Changqian became grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 六月，蘇良嗣為文昌左相，天官尚書韋待價為文昌右相，並同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Su Liangsi became Left Minister of the Department of State Affairs; Wei Daibao, Minister of Heaven, became Right Minister—both equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Su Liangsi became left minister of state and Wei Daibao right minister, each of third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.

sentences.zh: 右肅政御史大夫韋思謙為納言。

translations.literal: Wei Siqian, Censor-in-Chief of the Right Office for Censorial Reform, became Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Siqian, censor-in-chief of the Right Office for Censorial Reform, became remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，封皇子成義為恆王，隆基為楚王，隆範為衛王，隆業為趙王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, Prince Chengyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Heng, Longji as Prince of Chu, Longfan as Prince of Wei, and Longye as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of the third year Chengyi was made Prince of Heng, Longji Prince of Chu, Longfan Prince of Wei, and Longye Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 二月，韋思謙請致仕，許之。

translations.literal: In the second month Wei Siqian requested retirement; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Wei Siqian asked to retire and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，裴居道為納言，夏官侍郎張光輔為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Pei Judao became Remonstrator; Zhang Guangfu, vice minister of summer affairs, became vice minister at Phoenix Pavilion, equal in rank to the Phoenix Terrace chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Pei Judao became remonstrator and Zhang Guangfu, vice minister of summer affairs, joined the Phoenix Terrace as vice minister and chancellor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，劉禕之賜死於家。

translations.literal: On gengwu Liu Yizhi was granted death at home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Yizhi was ordered to take his own life at home.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，地官尚書魏玄同檢校納言。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn Wei Xuantong, Minister of Earth, was made acting Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Wei Xuantong, minister of earth, was appointed acting remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月，毀乾元殿，就其地造明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the fourth year the Qianyuan Hall was demolished and the Bright Hall built on its site.
translations.idiomatic: In the second spring month of the fourth year Qianyuan Hall was torn down and the Bright Hall raised in its place.

sentences.zh: 山東、河南甚饑乏，詔司屬卿王及善、司府卿歐陽通、冬官侍郎狄仁傑巡撫賑給。

translations.literal: Shandong and Henan suffered severe famine; Wang Jishan, Director of Retainers; Ouyang Tong, Director of the Palace Storehouse; and Di Renjie, vice minister of winter affairs, were ordered on inspection tours to relieve and supply.
translations.idiomatic: With Shandong and Henan in famine, Wang Jishan, Ouyang Tong, and Di Renjie were sent to inspect, relieve, and provision the stricken regions.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，魏王武承嗣偽造瑞石，文云：「聖母臨人，永昌帝業。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Prince Wu Chengsi of Wei forged an auspicious stone inscribed: "The Holy Mother presides over the people; the imperial line shall flourish forever.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Prince Wu Chengsi of Wei forged a prophetic stone that read, "The Holy Mother rules mankind; the imperial house shall flourish forever.

sentences.zh: 」令雍州人唐同泰表稱獲之洛水。

translations.literal: " A man of Yongzhou, Tang Tongtai, memorialized that it had been obtained from the Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: " Tang Tongtai of Yongzhou reported its discovery in the Luo River.

sentences.zh: 皇太后大悅，號其石為「寶圖」，擢授同泰遊擊將軍。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was greatly pleased, named the stone the "Treasure Chart," and promoted Tongtai to general of the mobile guard.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager rejoiced, named the stone the Treasure Chart, and made Tongtai a general of the mobile guard.

sentences.zh: 五月，皇太后加尊號曰聖母神皇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the empress dowager added the honorific title Holy Mother, Divine Sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month she took the added honorific Holy Mother, Divine Sovereign.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 改「寶圖」曰「天授聖圖」，封洛水神為顯聖，加位特進，並立廟。

translations.literal: The "Treasure Chart" was renamed the "Chart Bestowed by Heaven," the spirit of the Luo was enfeoffed as Manifest Sage with special advancement, and a temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Treasure Chart was retitled the Chart Bestowed by Heaven; the Luo spirit was enfeoffed Manifest Sage with special advancement and given a temple.

sentences.zh: 就水側置永昌縣。

translations.literal: Beside the river the county of Yongchang was established.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang County was founded on the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 天下大酺五日。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm there were five days of public feasting.
translations.idiomatic: The empire feasted for five days.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，博州刺史、琅邪王沖據博州起兵，命左金吾大將軍丘神勣為行軍總管討之。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eighth month Prince Chong of Langye, prefect of Bozhou, seized Bozhou and raised troops; Qiu Shenji, general of the Left Golden Crow Guard, was appointed campaigning commander to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the eighth month Prince Chong of Langye, prefect of Bozhou, rebelled; Qiu Shenji of the left golden crow guard was named campaigning commander against him.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，沖父豫州刺史、越王貞又舉兵於豫州，與沖相應。

translations.literal: On gengxu Chong's father Zhen, Prince of Yue and prefect of Yuzhou, also raised troops at Yuzhou in concert with Chong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Chong's father Zhen, Prince of Yue and prefect of Yuzhou, rose at Yuzhou in support.

sentences.zh: 九月，命內史岑長倩、鳳閣侍郎張光輔、左監門大將軍鞠崇裕率兵討之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Cen Changqian, Grand Secretary; Zhang Guangfu, vice minister at Phoenix Pavilion; and Ju Chongyu, general of the Left Gate Guard, were ordered to lead troops in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Cen Changqian, Zhang Guangfu, and Ju Chongyu were ordered to march against them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，斬貞及沖等，傳首神都，改姓為虺氏。

translations.literal: On bingyin Zhen, Chong, and the rest were beheaded; their heads were sent to the Divine Capital, and their surname was changed to Hui.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhen, Chong, and their fellows were executed; their heads were displayed in the Divine Capital and the clan renamed Hui.

sentences.zh: 曲赦博州。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted for Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou alone received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 韓王元嘉、魯王靈夔、元嘉子黃國公譔、靈夔子左散騎常侍范陽王藹、霍王元軌及子江都王緒、故虢王元鳳子東莞公融坐與貞通謀，元嘉、靈夔自殺，元軌配流黔州，譔等伏誅，改姓虺氏。

translations.literal: Prince Yuancheng of Han, Prince Lingqian of Lu, Yuancheng's son Chan the Duke of Huang, Lingqian's son Ai the Prince of Fanyang and left attendant of the cavalry, Prince Yuan'gui of Huo and his son Xu the Prince of Jiangdu, and Rong the Duke of Dongguan, son of the late Prince Yuanfeng of Guo, were implicated in plotting with Zhen; Yuancheng and Lingqian killed themselves, Yuan'gui was banished to Qianzhou, and Chan and the rest were executed—their surname changed to Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Yuancheng of Han and Lingqian of Lu, their sons Chan and Ai, Prince Yuan'gui of Huo and his son Xu, and Rong of Dongguan, son of the late Prince Yuanfeng of Guo, were judged complicit with Zhen; Yuancheng and Lingqian took their own lives, Yuan'gui was exiled to Qianzhou, and the rest were executed—the clan renamed Hui.

sentences.zh: 自是宗室諸王相繼誅死者，殆將盡矣。

translations.literal: From this the imperial princes were executed one after another, until they were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter imperial princes were killed in succession until the house was nearly extinct.

sentences.zh: 其子孫年幼者咸配流嶺外，誅其親党數百餘家。

translations.literal: Their young sons and grandsons were all banished beyond the ranges, and several hundred families of their kin and partisans were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Young heirs were exiled beyond the mountains; kin and allies of hundreds of families were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，神皇拜洛水，受「天授聖圖」，是日還宮。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the twelfth month the Divine Sovereign worshipped at the Luo River and received the Chart Bestowed by Heaven; that day she returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the twelfth month the Divine Sovereign worshipped the Luo and received the Chart Bestowed by Heaven, then returned to court the same day.

sentences.zh: 明堂成。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 六月，令文武官五品已上各舉所知。

translations.literal: In the sixth month civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above were ordered each to recommend someone known to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month every civil and military official of the fifth rank or higher was ordered to nominate a worthy man.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，紀王慎被誣告謀反，載以檻車，流于巴州，改姓虺氏。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn Prince Shen of Ji was falsely accused of plotting rebellion, loaded into a caged cart, and banished to Bazhou; his surname was changed to Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Prince Shen of Ji was denounced for treason, carted in a cage to Bazhou, and renamed Hui.

sentences.zh: 韋待價坐遲留不進，士卒多饑饉而死，配流繡州。

translations.literal: Wei Daibao was punished for delay in advancing; many soldiers died of hunger, and he was banished to Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Daibao was punished for slow marching; his troops starved in great numbers, and he was exiled to Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，左肅政御史大夫王本立同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Wang Benli, Censor-in-Chief of the Right Office for Censorial Reform, was made equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wang Benli, censor-in-chief of the Right Office for Censorial Reform, joined the third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，誅內史張光輔。

translations.literal: On xinsi Grand Secretary Zhang Guangfu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court executed Grand Secretary Zhang Guangfu.

sentences.zh: 九月，納言魏玄同賜死於家。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Remonstrator Wei Xuantong was granted death at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Remonstrator Wei Xuantong was ordered to die at home.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，春官尚書范履冰、鳳閣侍郎邢文偉並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Fan Lubing, Minister of Spring; and Xing Wenwei, vice minister at Phoenix Pavilion, were both made equal in rank to the Phoenix Terrace chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Fan Lubing and Xing Wenwei were both made chancellors of the Phoenix Terrace.

sentences.zh: 改羽林軍百騎為千騎。

translations.literal: The hundred riders of the Imperial Guard were changed to a thousand riders.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Guard's hundred riders were expanded to a thousand.

sentences.zh: 載初元年春正月，神皇親享明堂，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the inaugural year of Zaichu, the Divine Sovereign personally performed sacrifice at the Bright Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Zaichu 1 the Divine Sovereign sacrificed at the Bright Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 依周制建子月為正月，改永昌元年十一月為載初元年正月，十二月為臘月，改舊正月為一月，大酺三日。

translations.literal: Following Zhou practice the zi month was made the year's opening; the eleventh month of Yongchang 1 was reckoned the first month of Zaichu 1, the twelfth month became the year-end month, and the former first month was renamed the First Month; there were three days of public feasting.
translations.idiomatic: Adopting the Zhou calendar, the zi month opened the year; Yongchang 1's eleventh month became Zaichu 1's first month, the twelfth became the year-end month, and the old New Year month was redesignated the First Month; the court feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 神皇自以「曌」字為名，遂改詔書為制書。

translations.literal: The Divine Sovereign took the character Zhao as her name, and therefore changed edicts to "imperial pronouncements."
translations.idiomatic: Because she had adopted the character Zhao as her name, edicts were renamed imperial pronouncements.

sentences.zh: 春一月，蘇良嗣為特進，武承嗣為文昌左相，岑長倩為文昌右相，裴居道為太子少傅，並依舊同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: In the first month, Su Liangsi became special advancement; Wu Chengsi became Left Minister of the Department of State Affairs; Cen Changqian became Right Minister; Pei Judao became Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent—all retaining equal rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the new first month Su Liangsi became special advancement; Wu Chengsi left minister of state; Cen Changqian right minister; Pei Judao junior tutor to the heir—all of third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.

sentences.zh: 鳳閣侍郎武攸甯為納言，邢文偉為內史。

translations.literal: Wu Youning, vice minister at Phoenix Pavilion, became Remonstrator; Xing Wenwei became Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Youning became remonstrator; Xing Wenwei became grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，殺豫章王亶，遷其父舒王元名於和州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn Prince Dan of Yuzhang was killed, and his father Prince Yuanming of Shu was moved to Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Prince Dan of Yuzhang was executed and his father Prince Yuanming of Shu was exiled to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 有沙門十人偽撰《大雲經》，表上之，盛言神皇受命之事。

translations.literal: Ten monks forged the Great Cloud Sutra and presented it, lavishly proclaiming the Divine Sovereign's mandate to rule.
translations.idiomatic: Ten monks forged the Great Cloud Sutra and presented it, proclaiming at length that Heaven had chosen the Divine Sovereign.

sentences.zh: 制頒于天下，令諸州各置大雲寺，總度僧千人。

translations.literal: An imperial pronouncement was issued throughout the realm ordering each prefecture to establish a Great Cloud Monastery and ordain a thousand monks in all.
translations.idiomatic: A pronouncement ordered every prefecture to found a Great Cloud Monastery and ordain a thousand monks empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，殺隨州刺史澤王上金、舒州刺史許王素節並其子數十人。

translations.literal: On dinghai Prince Shangjin of Ze, prefect of Suizhou, and Prince Sunjie of Xu, prefect of Shuzhou, together with several tens of their sons, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Princes Shangjin of Ze and Sunjie of Xu, with dozens of their sons, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月九日壬午，革唐命，改國號為周。

translations.literal: On renwu, the ninth day of the ninth month, the mandate of Tang was set aside and the state name changed to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Double Ninth, Tang's mandate was cast off and the dynasty renamed Zhou.

sentences.zh: 改元為天授，大赦天下，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: The era name was changed to Tianshou, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and seven days of public feasting were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The era was renamed Tianshou; the court proclaimed a general amnesty and granted seven days of feasting.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，加尊號曰聖神皇帝，降皇帝為皇嗣。

translations.literal: On yiyou the honorific title Holy Divine Emperor was added, and the emperor was demoted to imperial heir.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou she took the title Holy Divine Emperor and reduced the emperor to imperial heir.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，初立武氏七廟於神都。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Wu clan ancestral temple was first established at the Divine Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Wu ancestral shrine was founded in the Divine Capital for the first time.

sentences.zh: 追尊神皇父贈太尉、太原王士彠為孝明皇帝。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored the Divine Sovereign's father, the late Grand Marshal and Prince of Taiyuan Shi Yue, as Emperor Xiaoming.
translations.idiomatic: She posthumously ennobled her father Shi Yue—late grand marshal and Prince of Taiyuan—as Emperor Xiaoming.

sentences.zh: 兄子文昌左相承嗣為魏王，天官尚書三思為梁王，堂侄懿宗等十二人為郡王。

translations.literal: Nephew Chengsi, left chancellor of the Secretariat, was made Prince of Wei; Sizan, minister of celestial offices, Prince of Liang; twelve clansmen including Yizong were made commandery princes.
translations.idiomatic: Her nephew Chengsi became Prince of Wei; Sizan, minister of celestial offices, Prince of Liang; and twelve kinsmen including Yizong were enfeoffed as commandery princes.

sentences.zh: 司賓卿史務滋為納言，鳳閣侍郎宗秦客為內史。

translations.literal: Shi Wuzi, director of ceremonial guests, became chief counselor; Zong Qinke, vice minister of Fengge, became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wuzi, director of ceremonial guests, was made chief counselor; Zong Qinke, Fengge vice minister, Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 給事中傅遊藝為鸞台侍郎，仍依舊知鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Fu Youyi, palace attendant, became vice minister of Luantai and retained his associate councilorship of Fengge-Luantai.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Youyi, palace attendant, became Luantai vice minister while keeping his Fengge-Luantai associate councilorship.

sentences.zh: 令史務滋等十人分道存撫天下。

translations.literal: Ordered Shi Wuzi and ten others to travel separate circuits comforting and reviewing the realm.
translations.idiomatic: She dispatched Shi Wuzi and ten others on separate circuits to comfort and inspect the realm.

sentences.zh: 改內外官所佩魚並作龜。

translations.literal: Changed the fish tally badges worn by inner and outer officials to turtle badges.
translations.idiomatic: Court tally badges—fish for all inner and outer officials—were changed to turtles.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，改并州文水縣為武興縣，依漢豐、沛例，百姓子孫相承給復。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, Bingzhou's Wenshui County was renamed Wuxing County; following the Han precedents of Feng and Pei, descendants of its people received hereditary tax exemptions.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Wenshui in Bingzhou became Wuxing County; like Han Feng and Pei, its people's descendants received hereditary tax relief.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，親祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 2, she personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of her second year she personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 春三月，改唐太廟為享德廟。

translations.literal: In the third spring month, the Tang ancestral temple was renamed the Temple of Honored Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third spring month the Tang ancestral temple was retitled the Temple of Honored Virtue.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，令釋教在道法之上，僧尼處道士女寇之前。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, Buddhism was ranked above Daoism, monks and nuns taking precedence over Daoist clergy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Buddhism was placed above the Way: monks and nuns took rank before Daoist priests and nuns.

sentences.zh: 六月，命岑長倩率諸軍討吐蕃。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Cen Changqian was ordered to lead the armies against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Cen Changqian was ordered to lead the armies against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 左肅政御史大夫格輔元為地官尚書，鸞台侍郎樂思晦並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Ge Fuyuan, left censor-in-chief, became minister of terrestrial offices; Yue Sihui, Luantai vice minister, became Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Fuyuan, left censor-in-chief, became minister of terrestrial offices; Yue Sihui, Luantai vice minister, joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，徙關內雍、同等七州戶數十萬以實洛陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, a hundred thousand households from seven Guanzhong prefectures including Yong and Tong were moved to populate Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month a hundred thousand households from seven Guanzhong circuits including Yong and Tong were relocated to swell Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 分京兆置鼎、稷、鴻、宜四州。

translations.literal: Jingzhao was divided to establish the four prefectures Ding, Ji, Hong, and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao was split into the four prefectures Ding, Ji, Hong, and Yi.

sentences.zh: 夏官尚書歐陽通知納言事。

translations.literal: Ouyang Tong, minister of summer offices, was given charge of chief counselor duties.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Tong, minister of summer offices, was assigned to handle chief counselor affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月，傅遊藝下獄死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Fu Youyi was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Fu Youyi was thrown into prison and died there.

sentences.zh: 右羽林衛大將軍、建昌王攸寧為納言，洛州司馬狄仁傑為地官侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: You Ning, right general of the Feathered Forest Guards and Prince of Jianchang, became chief counselor; Di Renjie, Luozhou vice prefect, became vice minister of terrestrial offices and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: You Ning, right general of the Feathered Forest and Prince of Jianchang, became chief counselor; Di Renjie, Luozhou vice prefect, became terrestrial vice minister and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，制官人者咸令自舉。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, an edict ordered that all officeholders must nominate themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month an edict required every officeholder to nominate himself for appointment.

sentences.zh: 殺文昌左相岑長倩、納言歐陽通、地官尚書格輔元。

translations.literal: Cen Changqian, left chancellor, Ouyang Tong, chief counselor, and Ge Fuyuan, minister of terrestrial offices, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Changqian, left chancellor, Ouyang Tong, chief counselor, and Ge Fuyuan, minister of terrestrial offices, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，親祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 3, she personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year she again sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person.

sentences.zh: 春一月，冬官尚書楊執柔同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: In the first spring month, Yang Zhirou, minister of winter offices, became Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month Yang Zhirou, minister of winter offices, joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 三月，五天竺國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, all five Indic realms sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month all five Indic realms sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 四月，大赦天下，改元為如意，禁斷天下屠殺。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name changed to Ruyi, and slaughter throughout the realm was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month she proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era to Ruyi, and forbade slaughter throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，大雨，洛水泛溢，漂流居人五千餘家，遣使巡問賑貸。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month torrential rain flooded the Luo; more than five thousand households were swept away, and envoys were sent to inquire after them and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month heavy rains made the Luo overflow and swept away more than five thousand households; envoys were sent to inquire and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，魏王承嗣為特進，建昌王攸寧為冬官尚書，楊執柔為地官尚書，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Prince of Wei Chengsi became special advance; Prince of Jianchang You Ning, minister of winter offices; Yang Zhirou, minister of terrestrial offices—all were removed from council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince of Wei Chengsi became special advance; Prince of Jianchang You Ning, minister of winter offices; Yang Zhirou, minister of terrestrial offices—all left the council.

sentences.zh: 秋官侍郎崔元琮為鸞台侍郎，夏官侍郎李昭德為鳳閣侍郎，檢校天官侍郎姚璹為文昌左丞，地官侍郎李元素為文昌右丞，並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Yuanzong, autumn offices vice minister, became Luantai vice minister; Li Zhaode, summer offices vice minister, Fengge vice minister; Yao Shuo, acting celestial offices vice minister, left secretariat aide; Li Yuansu, terrestrial offices vice minister, right secretariat aide—all became Fengge-Luantai associate councilors.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuanzong became Luantai vice minister; Li Zhaode, Fengge vice minister; Yao Shuo, left secretariat aide; Li Yuansu, right secretariat aide—all joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 九月，大赦天下，改元為長壽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, general amnesty; era changed to Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month she proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era to Longevity.

sentences.zh: 改用九月為社，大酺七日。

translations.literal: The she harvest rite was moved to the ninth month, with a seven-day court feast.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn she rite was fixed in the ninth month, and the court feasted for seven days.

sentences.zh: 并州改置北都。

translations.literal: Bingzhou was re-established as Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Bingzhou was re-established as the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，武威軍總管王孝傑大破吐蕃，復龜茲、於闐、疏勒、碎葉鎮。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month Wang Xiaojie, protector-general of Wuwei Army, routed Tibet and recovered the garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar, and Suyab.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Wang Xiaojie, Wuwei protector-general, crushed Tibet and recovered Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar, and Suyab.

sentences.zh: 二年春一月，親享明堂。

translations.literal: In the first spring month of year 2, she personally offered at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of the second year she personally offered at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，殺皇嗣妃劉氏、竇氏。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Imperial Heir's consorts Lady Liu and Lady Dou were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Imperial Heir's consorts, the Ladies Liu and Dou, were executed.

sentences.zh: 臘月，改封皇孫成器為壽春郡王，恆王成義為衡陽郡王，隆基為臨淄郡王，衛王隆範為巴陵郡王，隆業為彭城郡王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, imperial grandsons were re-enfeoffed: Chengi as Prince of Shouchun commandery, Chengyi as Hengyang, Longji as Linzi, Longfan as Baling, Longye as Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month her grandsons were re-enfeoffed: Chengi Prince of Shouchun, Chengyi of Hengyang, Longji of Linzi, Longfan of Baling, Longye of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 春二月，尚方監裴匪躬坐潛謁皇嗣，腰斬於都市。

translations.literal: In the second spring month, Pei Feigong, director of imperial manufactories, was bisected at the waist in the marketplace for secretly visiting the Imperial Heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the second spring month Pei Feigong, director of imperial manufactories, was cut in two at the waist in the marketplace for secretly visiting the Imperial Heir.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，上加金輪聖神皇帝號，大赦天下，大酺七日。

translations.literal: In the ninth autumn month the sovereign added the title Golden Wheel Sage Spirit Emperor, proclaimed amnesty, and feasted seven days.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth autumn month she took the added title Golden Wheel Sage Spirit Emperor, proclaimed amnesty, and feasted for seven days.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，司賓卿豆盧欽望為內史，文昌右丞韋巨源同鳳閣鸞台平章事，秋官侍郎陸元方為鸞台侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Doulu Qinwang, ceremonial guests director, became Secretariat Director; Wei Juyuan, right secretariat aide, and Lu Yuanfang, autumn offices vice minister and Luantai vice minister, became associate councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Doulu Qinwang became Secretariat Director; Wei Juyuan and Lu Yuanfang joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 三年春一月，親享明堂。

translations.literal: In the first spring month of year 3, she personally offered at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Again in the first spring month of the third year she sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person.

sentences.zh: 三月，鳳閣侍郎李昭德檢校內史，鸞台侍郎蘇味道同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Third month: Li Zhaode acting neishi; Su Weidao associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Zhaode became acting Secretariat Director; Su Weidao joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 韋巨源為夏官侍郎，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: Wei Juyuan summer offices vice minister, retained council duties.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Juyuan became summer offices vice minister while retaining his seat on the council.

sentences.zh: 四月，夏官尚書王孝傑同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Wang Xiaojie third rank deliberative.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Wang Xiaojie, minister of summer offices, was made deliberative third rank with Fengge-Luantai.

sentences.zh: 五月，上加尊號為越古金輪聖神皇帝，大赦天下，改元為延載，大酺七日。

translations.literal: Fifth month: added title Transcendent Golden Wheel Sage Spirit Emperor, amnesty, Yanzai era, seven-day feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month she added the title Transcendent Golden Wheel Sage Spirit Emperor, proclaimed amnesty, changed the era to Extended Reign, and feasted seven days.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，司賓少卿姚璹為納言。

translations.literal: Eighth autumn month: Yao Shuo chief counselor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Yao Shuo, vice director of ceremonial guests, became chief counselor.

sentences.zh: 左肅政御史中丞楊再思為鸞台侍郎，洛州司馬杜景儉為鳳閣侍郎，仍並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Yang Zaisi Luantai vice minister; Du Jingjian Fengge vice minister; both associate councilors.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi became Luantai vice minister and Du Jingjian Fengge vice minister; both joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 梁王武三思勸率諸蕃酋長奏請大征斂東都銅鐵，造天樞於端門之外，立頌以紀上之功業。

translations.literal: Prince of Liang Wu Sizan urged tribal chiefs to petition for levying copper and iron in the eastern capital to cast the Celestial Axis outside the Vermilion Gate and erect a monument praising the sovereign's achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Liang Wu Sizan urged the frontier chiefs to petition for a great levy of copper and iron in the eastern capital to cast the Celestial Axis outside the Vermilion Gate and raise a monument to her achievements.

sentences.zh: 九月，內史李昭德左授欽州南賓縣尉。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Li Zhaode demoted to Qinzhou Nanbin county captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Li Zhaode was demoted to captain of Nanbin County in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，文昌右丞李元素為鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth winter month: Li Yuansu associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Li Yuansu, right secretariat aide, joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 證聖元年春一月，上加尊號曰慈氏越古金輪聖神皇帝，大赦天下，改元，大酺七日。

translations.literal: Zhengsheng year 1 first month: added Maitreya Transcendent Golden Wheel title, amnesty, era change, seven-day feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Proof of Sagacity 1 she added the title Maitreya Transcendent Golden Wheel Sage Spirit Emperor, proclaimed amnesty, changed the era, and feasted seven days.

sentences.zh: 戊子，豆盧欽望、韋巨源、杜景儉、蘇味道、陸元方並左授趙、鄜、集、綏等州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Doulu Qinwang, Wei Juyuan, Du Jingjian, Su Weidao, Lu Yuanfang were all demoted to prefects of Zhao, Fu, Ji, Sui, etc.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Doulu Qinwang, Wei Juyuan, Du Jingjian, Su Weidao, and Lu Yuanfang were all demoted to prefects of Zhao, Fu, Ji, Sui, and the like.

sentences.zh: 丙申夜，明堂災，至明而並從煨燼。

translations.literal: On bingshen night the Bright Hall burned; by dawn it was ashes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen night the Bright Hall caught fire; by dawn it was nothing but ash.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以明堂災告廟，手詔責躬，令內外文武九品已上各上封事，極言正諫。

translations.literal: On gengzi, reported the fire to the ancestral temple, self-reproach edict, ordered all officials rank 9+ to submit sealed memorials with frank remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi she reported the blaze to the ancestral temple, issued a hand-edict blaming herself, and ordered civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above to submit sealed memorials with the frankest remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 春二月，上去慈氏越古尊號。

translations.literal: Second spring month: removed Maitreya Transcendent parts of title.
translations.idiomatic: In the second spring month she dropped the Maitreya and Transcendent portions of her title.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，親祀南郊，加尊號天冊金輪聖神皇帝，大赦天下，改元為天冊萬歲，大辟罪已下及犯十惡常赦所不原者，咸赦除之，大酺九日。

translations.literal: Ninth autumn month: southern suburb sacrifice, added Tianceshan Golden Wheel title, amnesty including capital crimes and ten abominations, Tianceshanwansui era, nine-day feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth autumn month she sacrificed at the southern suburb, added the title Heaven-Enregistered Golden Wheel Sage Spirit Emperor, proclaimed amnesty even for capital crimes and the ten abominations, changed the era to Heaven-Enregistered Ten Thousand Years, and feasted nine days.

sentences.zh: 萬歲登封元年臘月甲申，上登封于嵩嶽，大赦天下，改元，大酺九日。

translations.literal: Wansui Dengfeng year 1 twelfth month jiashen: feng on Mount Song, amnesty, era change, nine-day feast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the twelfth month in Ten Thousand Years Ascent-Feng 1 she performed the feng rite on Mount Song, proclaimed amnesty, changed the era, and feasted nine days.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禪於少室山。

translations.literal: Dinghai: shan at Mount Shaoshi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai she performed the shan rite at Mount Shaoshi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，又制內外官三品已上通前賜爵二等，四品已下加兩階。

translations.literal: Jichou: third rank+ given two noble ranks counting prior service, fourth rank and below two rank steps.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou she decreed that officials of the third rank and above receive two noble ranks counting prior honors, and those of the fourth rank and below two steps in rank.

sentences.zh: 洛州百姓給復二年，登封、告成縣三年。

translations.literal: Luozhou people tax exemption 2 years, Dengfeng and Gaocheng counties 3 years.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Luozhou received two years' tax relief; Dengfeng and Gaocheng counties, three.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，至自嵩嶽。

translations.literal: Guisi: returned from Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi she returned from Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 甲午，親謁太廟。

translations.literal: Jiawu: personally visited ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu she personally visited the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 春三月，重造明堂成。

translations.literal: Third spring month: Bright Hall rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the third spring month the Bright Hall was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，親享明堂，大赦天下，改元為萬歲通天，大酺七日。

translations.literal: Fourth summer month: offered at Bright Hall, amnesty, Wansui Tongtian era, seven-day feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month she offered at the Bright Hall, proclaimed amnesty, changed the era to Ten Thousand Years Penetrating Heaven, and feasted seven days.

sentences.zh: 以天下大旱，命文武官九品以上極言時政得失。

translations.literal: Great drought: ordered officials rank 9+ to speak frankly on government faults.
translations.idiomatic: Because of a great drought throughout the realm, she ordered civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above to speak frankly on the gains and losses of current policy.

sentences.zh: 五月，營州城傍契丹首領松漠都督李盡忠與其妻兄歸誠州刺史孫萬榮殺都督趙文翽，舉兵反，攻陷營州。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Khitan leader Li Jinzhong and brother-in-law Sun Wanrong killed Zhao Wenshui, rebelled, took Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Khitan leader Li Jinzhong and his brother-in-law Sun Wanrong, governor of Guicheng, killed the protector Zhao Wenshui, rose in revolt, and seized Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 盡忠自號可汗。

translations.literal: Jinzhong styled himself khan.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed himself khan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命鷹揚將軍曹仁師、右金吾大將軍張玄遇、右武威大將軍李多祚、司農少卿麻仁節等二十八將討之。

translations.literal: Yichou: 28 generals including Cao Renshi ordered to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou she ordered twenty-eight generals, including Cao Renshi, Zhang Xuanyu, Li Duozuo, and Ma Renjie, to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，命春官尚書、梁王三思為安撫大使，納言姚璹為之副。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Wu Sizan pacification commissioner, Yao Shuo deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Prince of Liang Wu Sizan was made pacification commissioner and Yao Shuo chief counselor his deputy.

sentences.zh: 制改李盡忠為盡滅，孫萬榮為萬斬。

translations.literal: Edict changed Li Jinzhong's name to Jinmie (exterminate-all) and Sun Wanrong to Wanzhan (ten-thousand-beheadings).
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed Li Jinzhong's name to Li Exterminate-All and Sun Wanrong's to Sun Ten-Thousand-Beheadings.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，張玄遇、曹仁師、麻仁節與李盡滅戰于西硤石黃麞穀，官軍敗績，玄遇、仁節並為賊所虜。

translations.literal: Eighth month: defeat at Xixiashi Huangzhang Valley, Zhang and Ma captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Zhang Xuanyu, Cao Renshi, and Ma Renjie fought Li Exterminate-All at Huangzhang Valley west of Xiashi Pass; the government army was routed and Zhang and Ma were captured.

sentences.zh: 九月，命右武衛大將軍、建安王攸宜為大總管以討契丹。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Prince of Jian'an You Yi grand commander against Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince of Jian'an You Yi, right general of the Martial Guard, was made grand commander to campaign against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 并州長史王方慶為鸞台侍郎，與殿中監李道廣並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Fangqing Luantai vice minister; Li Daoguang associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fangqing, Bingzhou chief administrator, became Luantai vice minister; Li Daoguang, palace director, joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇涼州，都督許欽明為賊所執。

translations.literal: Tibet raided Liangzhou; Xu Qinming captured.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Liang Prefecture and captured its protector Xu Qinming.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王方慶為鳳閣侍郎，仍依舊知政事。

translations.literal: Gengshen: Wang Fangqing Fengge vice minister, retained council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Fangqing became Fengge vice minister while retaining his seat on the council.

sentences.zh: 李盡滅死，其党孫萬斬代領其眾。

translations.literal: Li Jinmie died; Sun Wanzhan led the band.
translations.idiomatic: Li Exterminate-All died, and Sun Ten-Thousand-Beheadings took command of the rebels.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，孫萬斬攻陷冀州，刺史陸寶積死之。

translations.literal: Tenth winter month: Sun took Ji Prefecture; Lu Baoji killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Sun Ten-Thousand-Beheadings seized Ji Prefecture and killed its governor Lu Baoji.

sentences.zh: 十一月，又陷瀛州屬縣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: also took Yingzhou subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he also overran the counties subordinate to Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，親享明堂。

translations.literal: Year 2 first month: Bright Hall offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year she personally offered at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 鳳閣侍郎李元素、夏官侍郎孫元亨坐與綦連耀謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Li Yuansu and Sun Yuanheng executed for plotting with Qilian Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuansu, Fengge vice minister, and Sun Yuanheng, summer offices vice minister, were executed for plotting rebellion with Qilian Yao.

sentences.zh: 原州都督府司馬婁師德為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Lou Shide associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shide, Bingzhou protector staff officer, became Fengge vice minister and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.

sentences.zh: 春二月，王孝傑、蘇宏暉等率兵十八萬與孫萬斬戰于硤石谷，王師敗績，孝傑沒於陣，宏暉棄甲而遁。

translations.literal: Second spring month: 180,000 troops under Wang Xiaojie defeated at Xiashi Valley; Wang died in battle, Su Honghui fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second spring month Wang Xiaojie and Su Honghui led a hundred and eighty thousand men against Sun Ten-Thousand-Beheadings at Xiashi Valley; the imperial army was crushed, Wang Xiaojie fell in battle, and Su Honghui fled without his armor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，鑄九鼎成，置於明堂之庭，前益州大都督府長史王及善為內史。

translations.literal: Fourth summer month: Nine Cauldrons cast and placed in Bright Hall court; Wang Jishan neishi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the Nine Cauldrons were cast and set up in the Bright Hall courtyard; Wang Jishan, former chief administrator of Yizhou, became Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 五月，命右金吾大將軍、河內王懿宗為大總管，右肅政御史大夫婁師德為副大總管，右武威衛大將軍沙吒忠義為前軍總管，率兵二十萬以討孫萬斬。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Wu Yizong grand commander, Lou Shide deputy, Shazha Zhongyi vanguard, 200,000 to campaign against Sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Prince of Henei Wu Yizong was made grand commander, Lou Shide deputy grand commander, and Shazha Zhongyi vanguard commander, with two hundred thousand men to campaign against Sun Ten-Thousand-Beheadings.

sentences.zh: 八月，突厥默啜以延秀非唐室諸王，乃囚於別所，率眾與閻知微入寇媯、檀等州。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Turkic khan Mojie detained Yanxiu as not a Tang prince, invaded with Yan Zhiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Turkic khan Mojie, holding that Wu Yanxiu was no prince of the Tang house, imprisoned him separately and led his horde with Yan Zhiwei to raid Gui and Tan and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 命司屬卿高平王重規、右武威衛大將軍沙吒忠義、幽州都督張仁亶、右羽林衛大將軍李多祚等率兵二十萬逆擊，乃放延秀還。

translations.literal: 200,000 under Chonggui etc. counterattacked; Yanxiu released.
translations.idiomatic: She ordered Prince of Gaoping Chonggui, Shazha Zhongyi, Zhang Renyan, and Li Duozuo and others to lead two hundred thousand men against them, whereupon Yanxiu was released.

sentences.zh: 己丑，默啜攻陷定州，刺史孫彥高死之，焚燒百姓廬舍，遇害者數千人。

translations.literal: Jichou: Mojie took Dingzhou; Sun Yan'gao killed; thousands dead.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Mojie seized Ding Prefecture; Governor Sun Yan'gao was killed, commoners' houses burned, and thousands perished.

sentences.zh: 魏王承嗣卒。

translations.literal: Prince of Wei Chengsi died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wei Chengsi passed away.

sentences.zh: 庚子，梁王三思為內史，狄仁傑為納言。

translations.literal: Gengzi: Wu Sizan neishi, Di Renjie chief counselor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wu Sizan became Secretariat Director and Di Renjie chief counselor.

sentences.zh: 九月，建昌王攸寧同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: September: You Ning associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince of Jianchang You Ning joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 默啜攻陷趙州，刺史高睿遇害。

translations.literal: Mojie took Zhaozhou; Gao Rui killed.
translations.idiomatic: Mojie seized Zhao Prefecture and killed its governor Gao Rui.

sentences.zh: 丙子，廬陵王哲為皇太子，令依舊名顯，大赦天下，大酺五日。

translations.literal: Bingzi: Prince of Luling Zhe made crown prince, restored name Xian, amnesty, five-day feast.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince of Luling Zhe was made crown prince and ordered to resume his former name Xian; amnesty was proclaimed and the court feasted five days.

sentences.zh: 令納言狄仁傑為河北道行軍元帥。

translations.literal: Di Renjie ordered as Hebei campaign marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Di Renjie was ordered to serve as Hebei campaign marshal.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，皇太子謁太廟。

translations.literal: Xinsi: crown prince visited ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the crown prince visited the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 天官侍郎蘇味道鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Su Weidao associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Su Weidao, celestial offices vice minister, became Fengge vice minister and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，默啜盡殺所掠趙、定州男女萬餘人，從五回道而去，所至殘害，不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Guiwei: Mojie slaughtered 10,000+ captives from Zhao and Ding, withdrew via Wuhui road.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Mojie slaughtered more than ten thousand men and women he had seized in Zhao and Ding and withdrew by the Five-Turns road, ravaging everywhere he passed beyond count.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，夏官侍郎姚元崇、麟台少監李嶠並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanchong and Li Qiao associate councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Yao Yuanchong, summer offices vice minister, and Li Qiao, vice director of the Forest Terrace, joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 是月，閻知微自突厥叛歸，族誅之。

translations.literal: That month Yan Zhiwei fled back from Turks; entire clan executed.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Yan Zhiwei fled back from the Turks; his entire clan was executed to the last man.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月，封皇嗣旦為相王。

translations.literal: Year 2 second spring month: Imperial Heir Dan enfeoffed Prince of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second spring month of the second year the Imperial Heir Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 初為寵臣張易之及其弟昌宗置控鶴府官員，尋改為奉宸府，班在御史大夫下。

translations.literal: First established Control-Crane Bureau for Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong; renamed Attendant-Court Bureau, ranked below censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: She first established the Control-Crane Bureau for her favorites Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong; it was soon renamed the Attendant-Court Bureau, ranking just below the censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 左肅政御史中丞魏元忠為鳳閣侍郎，吉頊為天官侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Wei Yuanzhong and Ji Xu associate councilors.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanzhong, left censor, became Fengge vice minister, and Ji Xu celestial vice minister; both joined the Fengge-Luantai council.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸嵩山，過王子晉廟。

translations.literal: Wuzi: visited Mount Song, passed Prince Zijin's shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi she went to Mount Song and passed the shrine of Prince Zijin.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸緱山。

translations.literal: Bingshen: visited Mount Gou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen she visited Mount Gou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，至自嵩山。

translations.literal: On dingyou, returned from Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou she returned from Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，吐蕃大論贊婆來奔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Tibet's grand councilor Zanpo came to defect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Zanpo, Tibet's grand councilor, fled to the court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，上以春秋高，慮皇太子、相王與梁王武三思、定王武攸寧等不協，令立誓文於明堂。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: The Emperor, being advanced in years, feared that the Crown Prince, the Prince of Xiang, and the Liang Prince Wu Sansi, the Prince of Ding Wu Youning, and the like would not be in harmony; she ordered an oath sworn at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, now aged, the Emperor feared strife between the crown prince, the Prince of Xiang, and the Liang Prince Wu Sansi, the Prince of Ding Wu Youning, and their factions; she had them swear an oath in the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 八月，王及善為文昌左相，豆盧欽望為文昌右相，仍並同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Wang Jishan became Director of the Left of the Wenchang Platform; Dou Lu Qinwang became Director of the Right, both still co-equal with Fengge and Luantai third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wang Jishan was made left director of the Wenchang Platform and Dou Lu Qinwang right director, each retaining third-rank standing at Fengge and Luantai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，幸福昌縣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yihai: Visited Xingfuchang County.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the tenth winter month she visited Xingfuchang County.

sentences.zh: 王及善薨。

translations.literal: Wang Jishan died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jishan died at court.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊寅，梁王三思為特進，天官侍郎吉頊配流嶺表。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, wuyin: Liang Prince Wu Sansi was made specially advanced; Palace Ministry Vice Minister Ji Xu was sentenced to exile in Lingbiao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the first month of the third year Wu Sansi of Liang was promoted to specially advanced rank and Ji Xu, vice minister of the palace ministry, was banished to Lingbiao.

sentences.zh: 臘月辛巳，封皇太子男重潤為邵王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinsi: The Crown Prince's son Chongrun was enfeoffed as Prince of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, the crown prince's son Chongrun was created Prince of Shao.

sentences.zh: 狄仁傑為內史。

translations.literal: Di Renjie became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Di Renjie was appointed director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸汝州之溫湯。

translations.literal: wuyin: Visited the hot springs of Wen in Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin she traveled to the hot springs at Wen in Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自溫湯、造三陽宮於嵩山。

translations.literal: jiaxu: Returned from the hot springs; built the Three Yang Palace on Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu she returned from the springs and ordered the Three Yang Palace built on Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 春三月，李嶠為鸞台侍郎，知政事如故。

translations.literal: Spring, third month: Li Qiao became Luantai Vice Minister, managing affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third spring month Li Qiao was made vice minister of Luantai and kept his previous duties in government.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，幸三陽宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wushen: Visited the Three Yang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the fourth summer month she went to the Three Yang Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，上以所疾康復，大赦天下，改元為久視，停金輪等尊號，大酺五日。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guichou: Because her illness had healed, she proclaimed a great amnesty, changed the era name to Jiusi, abolished the Golden Wheel and other honorific titles, and held a grand feast for five days.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the fifth month, declaring herself recovered, she proclaimed a general amnesty, renamed the era Jiusi, dropped the Golden Wheel and other exalted titles, and granted five days of public revelry.

sentences.zh: 六月，魏元忠為左肅政御史大夫，仍舊知政事。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Wei Yuanzhong became Left Censor-in-Chief of the Bureau of Integrity, continuing to manage affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wei Yuanzhong was made left censor-in-chief of the Bureau of Integrity while retaining his seat in government.

sentences.zh: 是夏大旱。

translations.literal: That summer there was great drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer a severe drought struck.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，至自三陽宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Returned from the Three Yang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month she returned from the Three Yang Palace.

sentences.zh: 天官侍郎張錫為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事；

translations.literal: Palace Ministry Vice Minister Zhang Xi became Fengge Vice Minister and co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xi, vice minister of the palace ministry, was made Fengge vice minister and co-equal chief minister of Fengge and Luantai;

sentences.zh: 其甥鳳閣鸞台平章事李嶠為成均祭酒，罷知政事。

translations.literal: his nephew, Fengge Luantai Chief Minister Li Qiao, became Rector of the Directorate of Education and ceased managing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: his nephew Li Qiao, chief minister of Fengge and Luantai, was made rector of the Directorate of Education and left the council of state.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制曰：「隋尚書令楊素，昔在本朝，早荷殊遇。

translations.literal: renyin, edict: "Sui Minister-over-Ministers Yang Su, in former times in this court, early received extraordinary favor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict declared: "Yang Su, Sui minister-over-ministers, once served this dynasty and in youth received exceptional grace.

sentences.zh: 稟凶邪之德，有諂佞之才，惑亂君上，離間骨肉。

translations.literal: He bore a treacherous nature and possessed the talent of flattery; he confused the sovereign above and sundered flesh-and-blood kin.
translations.idiomatic: He carried a treacherous heart and a flatterer's wit; he bewildered his lord and set kin against kin.

sentences.zh: 搖動塚嫡，寧唯握蠱之禍；

translations.literal: He shook the legitimate heir—was it only the calamity of witchcraft he grasped?
translations.idiomatic: He unsettled the lawful heir—as if grasping witchcraft were not crime enough.

sentences.zh: 誘扇後主，卒成請蹯之釁。

translations.literal: He incited and fanned the later sovereign, until at last the crime of begging for a piece of flesh was complete.
translations.idiomatic: He goaded the later sovereign until the offense of begging flesh from one's own body was fully ripened.

sentences.zh: 隋室喪亡，蓋惟多僻，究其萌兆，職此之由。

translations.literal: The Sui house perished—was it not because of many perversities? Tracing the first sprout, the office lay here.
translations.idiomatic: The house of Sui fell because wickedness multiplied; trace the first seed of ruin and it leads here.

sentences.zh: 生為不忠之人，死為不義之鬼，身雖倖免，子竟族誅。

translations.literal: Alive he was an unfaithful man; dead he is an unrighteous ghost. Though his person escaped, his sons were exterminated to the clan.
translations.idiomatic: Living, he was faithless; dead, he is an unrighteous ghost. Though he himself was spared, his sons were wiped out to the last clan.

sentences.zh: 斯則奸逆之謀，是為庭訓；

translations.literal: Thus treacherous designs became household instruction;
translations.idiomatic: Thus treachery became the lesson taught at home;

sentences.zh: 險薄之行，遂成門風。

translations.literal: crafty and shallow conduct became the family style.
translations.idiomatic: cunning and shallow conduct became the family way.

sentences.zh: 刑戮雖加，枝胤仍在，何得肩隨近侍，齒列朝行？

translations.literal: Though punishment was added, branches and descendants remained—how could they shoulder-by-shoulder attend in close service and take rank in the court procession?
translations.idiomatic: Though the law struck them down, their line still stood—how could their descendants walk shoulder to shoulder with close attendants and take their places in court?

sentences.zh: 朕接統百王，恭臨四海，上嘉賢佐，下惡賊臣。

translations.literal: We, succeeding the hundred kings and reverently facing the four seas, above we praise worthy assistants, below we detest traitorous ministers.
translations.idiomatic: We, inheriting the hundred kings and facing the four seas in reverence, honor the worthy above and hate traitors below.

sentences.zh: 常欲從容于萬機之余，褒貶於千載之外，況年代未遠，耳目所存者乎！

translations.literal: We constantly wish, in the leisure after the myriad affairs, to praise and blame across a thousand years—how much more when the age is not distant and what the ears still hear is present!
translations.idiomatic: We have long wished, between the myriad affairs, to judge the dead across a thousand years—how much more when the age is near and the living still remember!

sentences.zh: 其楊素及兄弟子孫已下，並不得令任京官及侍衛。

translations.literal: Yang Su and his brothers' sons and grandsons and below—all are forbidden to hold capital office or serve as palace guards."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Su and his brothers' sons and grandsons and all below them are forbidden to hold office in the capital or serve as palace guards."

sentences.zh: 」九月，內史狄仁傑卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Secretariat Director Di Renjie died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Di Renjie, director of the Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，復舊正朔，改一月為正月，仍以為歲首，正月依舊為十一月，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiayin: Restored the former calendar; changed the first month back to the first month and again made it year's beginning; the former first month again became the eleventh month; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the tenth winter month she restored the old calendar, made the first month again the year's beginning and the former first month the eleventh, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 韋巨源為地官尚書，文昌左丞韋安石為鸞台侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Wei Juyuan became Minister of Earth; Wenchang Left Assistant Wei Anshi became Luantai Vice Minister and co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Juyuan was made minister of earth; Wei Anshi, left assistant of Wenchang, was made Luantai vice minister and co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸新安，曲赦其縣。

translations.literal: dingmao: Visited Xin'an; partial amnesty for that county.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao she visited Xin'an and granted a partial amnesty to the county.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至自新安。

translations.literal: renshen: Returned from Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen she returned from Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 十二月，開屠禁，諸祠祭令依舊用牲牢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: The slaughter ban was lifted; all sacrifices were ordered to use oxen and sheep as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month she lifted the ban on slaughter; all sacrifices were again to use oxen and sheep.

sentences.zh: 大足元年春正月，制改元。

translations.literal: First year of Dazu, spring first month: Edict changing the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dazu, on the first spring month, an edict changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 二月，鸞台侍郎李懷遠同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Second month: Luantai Vice Minister Li Huaiyuan became co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Li Huaiyuan, vice minister of Luantai, joined the council as co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 三月，姚元崇為鳳閣侍郎，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: Third month: Yao Yuanchong became Fengge Vice Minister, managing affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yao Yuanchong was made Fengge vice minister and kept his seat in government.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鳳閣侍郎張錫坐贓配循州。

translations.literal: bingshen: Fengge Vice Minister Zhang Xi, for corruption, was sentenced to exile in Xun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhang Xi, Fengge vice minister, was banished to Xun Prefecture on a charge of graft.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，幸三陽宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: Visited the Three Yang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month she went to the Three Yang Palace.

sentences.zh: 命左肅政御史大夫魏元忠為總管以備突厥。

translations.literal: Ordered Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Yuanzhong to serve as commander-in-chief to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: She ordered Wei Yuanzhong, left censor-in-chief, to serve as commander-in-chief against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 天官侍郎顧琮同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Palace Ministry Vice Minister Gu Cong became co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong, vice minister of the palace ministry, joined the council as co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 六月，夏官侍郎李迥秀同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Summer Office Vice Minister Li Jiongxiu became co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Li Jiongxiu, vice minister of the summer office, joined the council as co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曲赦告成縣。

translations.literal: xinwei: Partial amnesty for Gaocheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei she granted a partial amnesty to Gaocheng County.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，至自三陽宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiaxu: Returned from the Three Yang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the seventh month she returned from the Three Yang Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月，邵王重潤為易之讒構，令自死。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Prince of Shao Chongrun, framed by Yizhi, was ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince of Shao Chongrun, framed by Zhang Yizhi, was ordered to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，幸京師，大赦天下，改元為長安。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Visited the capital; great amnesty; changed the era name to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month she went to the capital, proclaimed a general amnesty, and renamed the era Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，突厥寇鹽、夏等州，殺掠人吏。

translations.literal: Second year, spring first month: The Turks raided Yan, Xia, and other prefectures, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year the Turks raided Yan, Xia, and other prefectures, slaughtering officials and people.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙丑，日有蝕之，不盡如鉤，京師及四方見之。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, yichou: There was a solar eclipse, not fully like a hook; the capital and the four directions saw it.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the ninth month the sun was eclipsed, not quite to a hook; the capital and the realm beheld it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，日本國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: The state of Japan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Japan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月，相王旦為司徒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Prince of Xiang Dan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Prince of Xiang, Dan, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 戊子，親祀南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: wuzi: Personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi she sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月壬戌，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Third year, spring third month, renxu: There was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the third spring month of the third year the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，相王旦表讓司徒，許之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengzi: Prince of Xiang Dan memorialized declining the post of Minister of Works; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the fourth summer month the Prince of Xiang, Dan, asked to resign as minister of works and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 改文昌台為中台。

translations.literal: The Wenchang Platform was renamed the Central Platform.
translations.idiomatic: The court renamed the Wenchang Platform the Central Platform.

sentences.zh: 李嶠知納言事。

translations.literal: Li Qiao managed the affairs of the Director of Proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiao took charge of the directorate of proclamations.

sentences.zh: 六月，寧州雨，山水暴漲，漂流二千餘家，溺死者千餘人。

translations.literal: Sixth month: In Ning Prefecture rain fell; mountains and rivers swelled violently; more than two thousand households were swept away; more than a thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Ning Prefecture was flooded; mountain torrents swept away more than two thousand households and drowned more than a thousand people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，殺右金吾大將軍唐休璟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Right Golden Guard General Tang Xiujing was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tang Xiujing, right general of the golden guards, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，正諫大夫硃敬則同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month: Direct Remonstrator Zhu Jingze became co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhu Jingze, direct remonstrator, joined the council as co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 戊申，相王旦為雍州牧。

translations.literal: wushen: Prince of Xiang Dan was made Governor of Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Prince of Xiang, Dan, was made governor of Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，御史大夫兼知政事、太子右庶子魏元忠為張昌宗所譖，左授端州高要尉。

translations.literal: That month: Censor-in-Chief and concurrent manager of affairs, Right Vice Tutor to the Heir Wei Yuanzhong was slandered by Zhang Changzong and demoted to defender of Gaoyao in Duan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wei Yuanzhong, censor-in-chief, councilor, and right vice tutor to the heir, was slandered by Zhang Changzong and demoted to defender of Gaoyao in Duan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 京師大雨雹，人畜有凍死者。

translations.literal: The capital had heavy rain and hail; men and livestock froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: A great hailstorm struck the capital; people and livestock froze to death.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，駕還神都。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingyin: The imperial carriage returned to Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the tenth winter month the court returned to Shendu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，至自京師。

translations.literal: yiyou: Returned from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou she returned from the capital.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，造興泰宮于壽安縣之萬安山。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring first month: Built Xingtai Palace on Mount Wan'an in Shou'an County.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of the fourth year she built Xingtai Palace on Mount Wan'an in Shou'an County.

sentences.zh: 天官侍郎韋嗣立為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: Palace Ministry Vice Minister Wei Silizhi became Fengge Vice Minister and co-equal Fengge Luantai Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Silizhi, vice minister of the palace ministry, was made Fengge vice minister and co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 硃敬則請致仕，許之。

translations.literal: Zhu Jingze requested retirement; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Jingze asked to retire and was permitted.

sentences.zh: 三月，進封平恩郡王重福為譙王，夏官侍郎宗楚客同鳳閣鸞台平章事。
